appLead: Browser-only matching. Files stay in this tab — nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.
privacyNote: All matching runs locally in this tab. Files never leave your device.
docsLead: Short guide for browser-only bank statement matching.
docsStep1: Upload a bank statement (PDF / CSV / TXT).
docsStep2: Upload the income report and the expense report.
docsStep3: Press Match. Comparison runs only in this tab.
docsStep4: Review unmatched rows and download the CSV if needed. Press Clear to reset.
docsMatchBody: Rows match on amount (±0.05), date (±1 day), and purpose text overlap. Near misses and rows present on only one side stay in the unmatched lists.
docsSamplesBody: Ready-made fixtures live in the repository. Download them, then upload in the app.
